notes.roles: hero = the object the video is about, the only thing that glows. mark = annotation ink (hand-drawn arrows, callout labels). badge = numbered chips and ticks in a sequence. fg/dim stay the diagram's own ink.
notes.accent: null means the diagram uses fg/dim. Set one hex per video only when a single quantity must be tracked across scenes; it is a fourth colour on top of the three roles, so use it rarely.
notes.stars: Deterministic starfield behind every scene (seed fixes the layout so frames are reproducible). Static: the reference look does not drift, and a moving field competes with the diagram.
notes.glow: Only the hero object gets a bloom, and only while it is the subject. Diagram strokes, text and captions never glow.
notes.safe: Instagram Reels overlays cover roughly the top 260px and bottom 340px of a 1080x1920 frame. Nothing that must be read goes there.
notes.font: Manim uses whatever is installed system-wide under this name. Remotion loads it from Google Fonts. Install locally for identical output.
notes.font_ja: Japanese videos load Noto Sans JP (engine/remotion/src/videos/<slug>/index.tsx) because Instrument Sans has no CJK glyphs. Same weights, same sizes; keep headline lines to 12 full-width characters.
